comparison.objective: Candidate commissions one adjustable shock absorber through test cycles; record transfers five microscope slides into separate staining-rack slots.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate requires tool seating, controlled fastener torque, cylindrical collar rotation, counterholding, and observation-driven retuning. Record requires repeated edge grasps and precise insertion of fragile, thin slides into narrow chamfered slots without tipping. Precision manipulation alone does not establish overlap.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires two compliant stops within energy, velocity, and stroke limits plus a retained collar setting. Record awards per-slide credit for correct unique-slot placement, upright orientation, release, rest, and no fall. Candidate does not numerically define overload, excessive rebound, or drift tolerance; those omissions do not resemble slide-placement criteria.
comparison.reason: Dynamic parameter adjustment and locking are meaningfully different from repeated thin-object pick-and-place insertion.
